title_zh: iPhone Duo 提前开炒，最高有人挂到 9.9 万
content_zh:
据第一财经报道，苹果首款折叠屏 iPhone Duo 发布后，黄牛已经提前开炒。

昨日，闲鱼等二手平台出现大量首发代抢服务，其中有商家将价格直接标到 9.9 万元，不过目前尚无成交记录。记者询问多位商家发现，目前 iPhone Duo 普遍加价约 5000 元，最低也在 1000 元以上，1TB、2TB 高配版本的行情还在继续上涨。部分预约抢购的定金也被炒至约 800 元，并注明「跑单不退」。

另一边，中国家电网调查发现，目前代抢服务费大约在 200～1000 元，iPhone Duo 普遍溢价超过 4000 元，顶配版本报价更高。由于距离正式预购还有一个多月，现在的市场交易主要围绕「首发代抢」和首批现货预期展开。

苹果官网显示，iPhone Duo 国行 256GB、512GB、1TB 和 2TB 版本分别售价 15999 元、17999 元、21499 元和 26499 元，10 月 16 日晚 8 点开启预购，10 月 23 日正式发售。以目前较普遍的 5000 元加价计算，入门版首发现货可能被喊到约 2.1 万元。
title_en: Scalpers Hyping Apple's iPhone Duo in China, Asking Prices Hit Up to $14,000
content_en:
Following the announcement of Apple's first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo, scalpers in China have already begun driving up prices ahead of its official release. On second-hand platforms like Xianyu, numerous "pre-order securing services" have emerged, with one seller listing the device for an astronomical 99,000 RMB (approx. $14,000 USD), though no transactions have been completed at this price.

Currently, scalpers are demanding an average premium of around 5,000 RMB ($700 USD), with a minimum markup of 1,000 RMB. The markup for high-end 1TB and 2TB versions continues to climb. Non-refundable deposit fees to secure a pre-order slot are being traded for around 800 RMB.

Official pricing for the iPhone Duo in China starts at 15,999 RMB ($2,250 USD) for the 256GB model and goes up to 26,499 RMB ($3,730 USD) for the 2TB version. Pre-orders are set to begin on October 16, with official sales starting on October 23. With the current average premium, the entry-level model is expected to cost buyers around 21,000 RMB on the secondary market.

title_zh: 三星借 iPhone Duo 发布调侃苹果「热剩饭」
content_zh:
苹果发布 iPhone Duo 期间，三星移动美国官方账号在 X 连续发文，称发布会内容「到目前为止，似曾相识」，随后又写道「等你们把我们的剩饭热完再告诉我们」。这些帖子没有在每句话中直接点名苹果，但发布时间和上下文均指向苹果首款折叠屏手机。

三星还拿 iPhone Duo 的命名和折叠形态开玩笑：它向多邻国账号表示「他们也抄了我们」，并称自己已经在做三折叠产品。三星 2019 年推出首款 Galaxy Fold，此次借官方账号强调苹果进入折叠屏市场的时间差；多邻国随后用表情包回应了三星的点名。

与此同时，罗永浩 9 月 10 日在个人微博发文，点评苹果首款折叠屏手机。他表示，折叠机形态、屏下摄像头、宽屏比例、侧面 Dock、内外屏接力、多角度悬停以及钛合金 3D 打印铰链盖等设计，此前已在其他折叠屏产品中出现过类似方案。
title_en: Samsung Mocks Apple's iPhone Duo Launch as "Reheating Leftovers"
content_en:
During the launch of the iPhone Duo, Samsung Mobile US took to X (formerly Twitter) to mock Apple's entry into the foldable smartphone market. In a series of posts, Samsung teased that the event felt like "déjà vu" and wrote, "Let us know when you're done reheating our leftovers," taking a swipe at Apple's delayed adoption of foldable technology.

Samsung also poked fun at the iPhone Duo's name and design, joking with Duolingo's official account that Apple "copied us" and boasting that Samsung is already developing tri-foldable devices. Samsung launched its first Galaxy Fold in 2019, and these posts highlight the multi-year gap between the two tech giants in the foldable space.

Meanwhile, Chinese tech figure Luo Yonghao also weighed in on Weibo, pointing out that the iPhone Duo's design elements—such as the foldable form factor, under-display camera, side dock, multi-angle hover, and titanium 3D-printed hinge—are features that have already been implemented by other smartphone manufacturers.

title_zh: OpenAI 暂停 ChatGPT Pro 20X 订阅，称 Astra 需求前所未有
content_zh:
OpenAI 今日凌晨宣布，暂停 ChatGPT Pro 20X（每月 200 美元）套餐的新订阅与升级，现有用户不受影响。

OpenAI 核心产品与平台负责人、原 Codex 主管 Tibo（Thibault Sottiaux）在社交平台表示，为确保现有用户体验并继续提供 Astra 模型访问权限，公司决定暂停对 200 美元 Pro 计划的订阅，称这类计划对系统压力最大，暂停订阅是「最小的一步」，以尽可能保留更广泛的访问权限。

他此前在 9 月 9 日已发帖预警称，用户对 Astra 的需求「前所未有」，团队正在拉动所有可用杠杆应对，如果需求持续增长，可能不得不暂停新的 Pro 订阅。
title_en: OpenAI Pauses New ChatGPT Pro Subscriptions Citing "Unprecedented" Demand for Astra
content_en:
OpenAI has announced a temporary pause on new subscriptions and upgrades for its $200-per-month ChatGPT Pro plan. The company stated that existing subscribers will not be affected by this decision.

Thibault Sottiaux, OpenAI's head of core product and platform, explained that the pause is necessary to ensure a high-quality experience for current users and to maintain stable access to the Astra model. Sottiaux noted that the high-tier Pro plan places the heaviest load on OpenAI's infrastructure, making the suspension a necessary step to preserve system capacity for the broader user base.

The decision follows a warning from Sottiaux earlier this week, where he noted that demand for the Astra model has been "unprecedented" and that the team was exhausting all available resources to manage the system load.

title_zh: 王腾创业后的首款产品来了，ISHO App 开启内测
content_zh:
9 月 9 日，前小米中国区市场部总经理、REDMI 品牌总经理王腾创立的睡眠科技品牌「今日宜休」ISHO 正式上线官方账号，并同步开启首款产品 ISHO App 的内测招募。

按照官方介绍，ISHO 希望从睡眠出发，将科技、AI 与健康科学结合，让用户的身体信号能够被记录和理解。首款 ISHO App 被定义为一款「实验性的 Agent」，会基于睡眠数据帮助用户理解自身状态、安排精力，并在持续使用中形成个性化的睡眠与精力恢复策略。

王腾透露，ISHO App 首期内测仅支持 iOS，并需要配合 Apple Watch 使用。现阶段团队会优先打磨 Apple Health 的数据接入和分析能力，后续再拓展更多平台。9 月 9 日晚，王腾表示内测已经吸引近万人报名，首批数百个邀请码已经开始发放。

硬件方面，今日宜休的第一款产品预计是一枚智能睡眠戒指。投资方 CMC 资本此前披露，该产品计划于今年 10 月正式发布；公司后续还规划睡眠耳机、智能手环、智能床罩及床垫等产品，希望围绕「精力指数」建立从监测、干预到改善的完整产品体系。
title_en: Former Xiaomi Executive Wang Teng's Sleep Tech Startup ISHO Launches Beta for First App
content_en:
ISHO, a sleep technology brand founded by Wang Teng—former General Manager of Xiaomi's China Marketing Department and the Redmi brand—has officially launched its social media presence and opened beta registration for its first product, the ISHO App.

Positioned as an "experimental Agent," the ISHO App leverages AI and health science to analyze sleep data, helping users track their physical signals, manage daily energy levels, and develop personalized sleep recovery strategies.

The initial beta is exclusive to iOS and requires an Apple Watch, as the team is currently prioritizing integration with Apple Health. According to Wang, nearly 10,000 users applied on the first night, and the first batch of invitation codes has been distributed.

On the hardware front, ISHO's first physical product is expected to be a smart sleep ring, slated for release in October, according to investor CMC Capital. The startup also plans to expand into sleep headphones, smart bands, and smart bedding to build a comprehensive ecosystem centered around a personalized "energy index."

title_zh: HSG 收购徕卡控股权的谈判终止
content_zh:
据德国媒体 n-tv 和 IT 之家报道，徕卡相机大股东 Andreas Kaufmann 已决定不出售控股权，HSG 与徕卡股东持续数月的交易谈判因此结束。Kaufmann 家族目前持有徕卡 55% 股份，私募机构 Blackstone 持有其余 45%。

报道援引知情人士称，双方没有在企业未来战略和交易价格上达成一致。HSG 原计划同时收购 Kaufmann 家族和 Blackstone 的股份，从而取得徕卡相机的多数控制权；谈判终止后，现有股权结构暂时维持不变。

徕卡与 HSG 均未在报道发布时公布后续安排。交易告吹后，品牌仍由 Kaufmann 家族控制；Blackstone 是否另寻退出机会，目前没有确定消息。
title_en: Acquisition Talks End as Leica Majority Shareholder Rejects HSG Takeover Bid
content_en:
Acquisition talks between HSG and Leica Camera's shareholders have collapsed after majority shareholder Andreas Kaufmann decided not to sell his controlling stake, according to reports from German media outlet n-tv and IT Home. The Kaufmann family currently owns 55% of Leica, while private equity firm Blackstone holds the remaining 45%.

Sources familiar with the matter revealed that the two parties failed to reach an agreement on Leica's future strategy and the transaction price. HSG had aimed to acquire shares from both the Kaufmann family and Blackstone to secure majority control of the iconic camera maker. Following the termination of talks, the current ownership structure will remain unchanged.

Neither Leica nor HSG has officially commented on the development. While the Kaufmann family retains control of the brand, it remains unclear whether Blackstone will seek alternative exit strategies.

title_zh: 黑客窃取 Claude 会话密钥，部分订阅用户额度异常消耗
content_zh:
TechCrunch 报道称，部分 Claude 订阅用户的登录会话遭信息窃取恶意软件劫持，攻击者随后用会话密钥生成未经授权的 Claude Code OAuth token，持续消耗账户使用额度。Anthropic 已向受影响用户发送警告，强制退出登录并撤销相关授权。

英国独立 AI 顾问 Grant de Swardt 的账户在闲置时仍持续消耗 Claude Max 额度。他关闭连接和定时任务后，额度使用量次日仍从 45% 上升至 55%。Anthropic 调查发现，一项可疑第三方服务正在使用被盗会话密钥；公司随后撤销会话与 token、恢复账户，并退还未使用的订阅时长。

Anthropic 表示，这类恶意软件并非经由 Claude 传播，但没有说明系统何时首次检测到异常，也无法向用户提供逐项使用记录。用户如收到类似警告，应重新登录、检查已授权应用，并撤销不认识的 Claude Code 或第三方连接。
title_en: Anthropic Warns Claude Subscribers of Session Hijacking and Unauthorized Usage
content_en:
Some Claude subscribers have had their accounts hijacked by info-stealing malware, allowing attackers to generate unauthorized Claude Code OAuth tokens and drain usage limits, TechCrunch reports. Anthropic has issued warnings to affected users, forcing logouts and revoking compromised authorizations.

The issue came to light after Grant de Swardt, an independent AI consultant in the UK, noticed his Claude Max limits were being consumed while his account was idle. Despite closing active connections, his usage continued to climb. Anthropic's investigation revealed that a suspicious third-party service was utilizing stolen session keys. The company has since revoked the compromised sessions, restored affected accounts, and refunded lost subscription time.

Anthropic clarified that the malware was not distributed through Claude's platform. However, the company did not disclose when the anomaly was first detected. Users who receive security warnings are advised to log back in, review authorized applications, and immediately revoke any unrecognized Claude Code or third-party integrations.

title_zh: OpenAI 限制图像和音频生成竞品在 ChatGPT 投放广告
content_zh:
据 The Information 报道，OpenAI 已通知部分广告合作伙伴，ChatGPT 不再接受与自家功能竞争的图像和音频生成产品广告。这项变化尚未写入 OpenAI 公开的广告政策页面，OpenAI 发言人拒绝置评。

Adobe 美洲媒体高级总监 Doug Wyatt 表示，Adobe 今年早些时候参与了 ChatGPT 广告试点，并曾为 Acrobat Studio 和 AI 图像生成工具 Firefly 投放广告。新规将图像和语音／音频品类关闭给竞品，视频生成类别目前仍可投放。

政策调整恰逢 OpenAI 发布 ChatGPT Images 2.5 之后。新模型已在本期「ChatGPT Images 2.5 上线」条目中介绍；本条聚焦平台对同类广告的新限制。
title_en: OpenAI Blocks Image and Audio AI Competitors from Advertising on ChatGPT
content_en:
OpenAI has notified some of its advertising partners that ChatGPT will no longer accept ads from competing image and audio generation products, according to a report by *The Information*. While this policy change has not yet been updated on OpenAI's public advertising policy page, a spokesperson for the company declined to comment.

Doug Wyatt, Adobe's Senior Director of Americas Media, confirmed that Adobe participated in a ChatGPT advertising pilot earlier this year, running ads for Acrobat Studio and its AI image generator, Firefly. Under the new restrictions, competitors in the image and voice/audio categories are blocked, though video generation tools are currently still permitted to advertise.

This policy shift coincides with the release of ChatGPT Images 2.5, signaling OpenAI's move to protect its ecosystem as it rolls out its own advanced generation capabilities.

title_zh: 曝奥迪在华重划双品牌：一汽负责四环、上汽主攻 AUDI
content_zh:
《财经》近日报道称，奥迪在中国重新分配品牌资源的方案已经基本确定：未来，一汽奥迪负责全球统一的四环品牌，上汽奥迪则集中运营面向中国市场、不使用四环标识的 AUDI 电动车品牌，具体落地细节仍在协商。

9 月 9 日，界面新闻从接近一汽奥迪的知情人士处获得进一步回应，对方称四环品牌归一汽奥迪的方向没有问题，奥迪中国与一汽集团合资合作事业部正在讨论实施细节。上汽大众表示相关事项由奥迪中国统一沟通；奥迪中国没有确认方案，只表示暂时没有更多信息披露。

奥迪集团 CEO 高德诺今年 3 月曾表示，公司会继续坚持与一汽和上汽合作的双伙伴战略。当前报道指向的是两套品牌的业务划分，并不等于奥迪已经宣布合并或终止其中一项合作；正式方案仍需等待奥迪方面确认。
title_en: Audi Reportedly Splits China Strategy: FAW to Keep Four Rings, SAIC to Drive "AUDI" EV Brand
content_en:
Audi is reportedly restructuring its dual-brand strategy in China. Under the new plan, FAW-Audi will retain exclusive management of the traditional, globally recognized "Four Rings" brand. Meanwhile, SAIC-Audi will focus on the "AUDI" electric vehicle brand—which does not use the iconic four-ring logo—specifically tailored for the Chinese market.

Insiders close to FAW-Audi confirmed that this brand division is the agreed-upon direction, with implementation details currently being negotiated. SAIC Volkswagen stated that all communications regarding this matter are being handled by Audi China, while Audi China has declined to share further details for the time being.

This move represents a strategic division of labor rather than a merger or termination of either partnership. Audi CEO Gernot Döllner previously reaffirmed the company's commitment to its dual-partner strategy with both FAW and SAIC.

title_zh: Kimi 开启全球人才招募，社招增设 7 个「Wild Card」名额
content_zh:
Kimi 9 月 9 日开启新一轮全球人才招募，覆盖社招、2027 届和 2028 届校招以及实习岗位。其中，社招设置 7 个「Wild Card」特别名额，面向不受单一岗位描述限制的复合型人才；入选者可与创始团队直接沟通，获得独立算力支持及按当前估值锁定的期权。

这些岗位可能参与下一代 Agent 产品、AI 产品工程、国际市场开拓、开源客户业务和组织建设。Kimi 在招聘条件中明确表示，绩点平平、休学辍学、创业失败或不擅长传统面试不会直接构成门槛，更看重作品、持续投入和跨领域能力。

校招和实习纳入「穿越计划」业务团队专场，不限岗位和专业，方向包括研发、产品、运营、设计、职能、销售、市场、国际化和管培生等；实习面向不限年级的在校学生。Kimi 还计划于 10 月 24 日在北京举行线下夜谈活动。
title_en: Moonshot AI's Kimi Launches Global Recruitment with "Wild Card" Roles for Non-Traditional Talents
content_en:
Kimi, the popular AI assistant developed by Moonshot AI, launched a new round of global recruitment on September 9. The hiring drive spans experienced professionals, campus recruits (classes of 2027 and 2028), and interns. Notably, the social recruitment track features seven "Wild Card" slots designed for versatile, multi-disciplinary talents who do not fit traditional job descriptions.

Selected "Wild Card" candidates will work directly with Kimi's founding team, receive dedicated computing power, and secure stock options locked at the company's current valuation. These roles will focus on next-generation AI agents, AI product engineering, international expansion, open-source client business, and organizational development.

Kimi emphasized that non-traditional backgrounds—such as average GPAs, dropping out of school, failed startups, or poor performance in conventional interviews—will not be barriers. Instead, the company is prioritizing actual portfolios, long-term commitment, and cross-disciplinary capabilities. The company also plans to host an offline networking event in Beijing on October 24.

title_zh: 支付宝每年投入 1000 万元设立「智能体涌现奖」
content_zh:
支付宝 9 月 10 日在 2026 Inclusion·外滩大会上宣布设立「智能体涌现奖」，年度大奖奖金为 100 万元。赛事面向个人、商家和机构开发者，首轮报名已启动，计划于 2027 年第四季度公布年度得主。

个人开发者可通过自然语言和 Vibe Coding 工具创作应用，商家和机构可接入支付宝 AI 开放平台。成熟的入围或获奖作品还可接入支付宝 AI 助手「阿宝」，向平台用户提供服务并持续经营。蚂蚁集团 CEO 韩歆毅在会上表示，智能体在「8 小时之外」的生活场景爆发是必然趋势。

支付宝同时升级了阿宝：目前已适配万余项服务，覆盖餐饮、酒旅、宠物和市民办事等 12 类生活服务，并新增异步任务能力。它还与星巴克推出「咖啡闹钟」：用户设定周期需求后，阿宝会在指定时间发起服务，由用户确认并完成支付。
title_en: Alipay Launches RMB 10M Annual AI Agent Award, Upgrades AI Assistant "Abao"
content_en:
At the Inclusion (Bund) Summit on September 10, Alipay announced the launch of the "AI Agent Emergence Award," pledging an annual investment of 10 million RMB (approximately $1.4 million) to foster AI development. The competition features a grand prize of 1 million RMB and is open to individual, merchant, and institutional developers. The first round of registrations has opened, with the inaugural annual winners set to be announced in the fourth quarter of 2027.

Individual developers can build applications using natural language and "Vibe Coding" tools, while businesses can integrate via Alipay's AI Open Platform. Outstanding entries will have the opportunity to integrate with Alipay's proprietary AI assistant, "Abao," allowing them to offer services directly to the platform's massive user base. Ant Group CEO Han Xinyi emphasized that the explosion of AI agents in daily lifestyle scenarios outside of working hours is an inevitable trend.

Alongside the award, Alipay unveiled a major upgrade to Abao. The AI assistant now supports over 10,000 services across 12 lifestyle categories, including dining, travel, pet care, and civic affairs. It also features new asynchronous task capabilities, highlighted by a "Coffee Alarm" collaboration with Starbucks that allows users to schedule recurring orders for automated execution.

title_zh: Mistral 融资 30 亿欧元，投后估值超过 210 亿欧元
content_zh:
Mistral 9 月 8 日宣布完成 30 亿欧元 D 轮融资，投后估值超过 210 亿欧元。三星电子领投，EQT 管理的 Scaleup Europe Fund 与现有投资方 PSG Equity 共同领投；贝莱德管理的基金、卢森堡大公国等成为新投资方，ASML、英伟达、a16z 等现有股东继续跟投。

公司表示，这笔资金将用于扩大前沿模型研究和训练算力，建设基础设施，并加快商业化与国际扩张。Mistral 目前在 20 个国家开展业务，为空中客车、ASML、汇丰等超过 125 家企业提供 AI 系统。

按 Mistral 的说法，这是欧洲科技公司迄今规模最大的单轮股权融资。继去年由 ASML 领投 C 轮后，Mistral 再次获得半导体企业牵头投资；公司把开放权重模型、自有算力与企业产品作为本轮扩张重点。
title_en: Mistral Secures €3 Billion Series D at €21 Billion Valuation in Europe's Largest Tech Round
content_en:
French AI startup Mistral has raised €3 billion in a Series D funding round, propelling its post-money valuation past €21 billion. The round was co-led by Samsung Electronics, EQT’s Scaleup Europe Fund, and existing investor PSG Equity. New backers include funds managed by BlackRock and the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg, while existing shareholders such as ASML, Nvidia, and Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) also participated.

According to Mistral, this transaction represents the largest single equity funding round for a European technology company to date. The capital will be used to expand frontier model research, secure training compute, build out infrastructure, and accelerate commercialization and international expansion.

Currently operating in 20 countries, Mistral provides AI systems to over 125 enterprise clients, including Airbus, ASML, and HSBC. For this next phase of growth, the company plans to focus heavily on open-weight models, proprietary computing power, and tailored enterprise products.

title_zh: 《旅行青蛙·中国之旅》续约条件未谈拢，运营方仍在磋商
content_zh:
《旅行青蛙·中国之旅》此前宣布，因 IP 授权合作到期，游戏将于 12 月 8 日 18:00 停止运营。9 月 9 日，第一财经援引一名接近运营方灵犀互娱的人士称，双方没有就续约条件达成一致，灵犀互娱仍在与 IP 方进行最后磋商。

这名人士表示，IP 方在续约过程中提出了较此前更严格的条件，并限制灵犀互娱开展联动活动和周边服务，双方多轮沟通后仍未达成协议。这一解释来自接近运营方的单一知情人士，目前没有得到 IP 方 Hit-Point 的确认。

灵犀互娱 9 月 8 日曾向南都表示，此次停运只与 IP 授权到期有关，与公司股权变更和战略调整无关。停运安排仅涉及中国大陆代理版本，Hit-Point 运营的日文原版仍会继续运行。
title_en: "Travel Frog: China Journey" Faces Shutdown Amid Stalled License Renewal Talks
content_en:
The popular mobile game *Travel Frog: China Journey* is scheduled to cease operations in mainland China on December 8 following the expiration of its IP licensing agreement. However, sources close to the publisher, Lingxi Games (a subsidiary of Alibaba), reveal that the company is still in last-minute negotiations with the Japanese IP owner, Hit-Point, in hopes of reaching a renewal agreement.

According to an insider, the negotiations stalled because Hit-Point proposed significantly stricter terms for the renewal. These new conditions reportedly restrict Lingxi Games from launching crossover events and selling branded merchandise. Hit-Point has not yet commented on these claims.

Lingxi Games previously clarified that the planned shutdown is solely due to the contract expiration and is unrelated to any internal corporate restructuring. The termination only affects the localized Chinese edition; the original Japanese version of the game, operated directly by Hit-Point, will remain unaffected.

title_zh: 人人影视 App 回归约 10 天后再次下架
content_zh:
据界面新闻 9 月 10 日报道，人人影视 App 在回归约 10 天后，已无法通过苹果 App Store 和多家安卓应用商店搜索到。已安装用户仍可打开应用，但内容分类从此前的电影、美剧、英剧、韩剧调整为电影和剧集两类。

应用内的 VIP 会员订阅目前也已暂停，资讯栏最新更新停留在 8 月 26 日。界面新闻就下架原因联系人人影视工作人员，截至报道发布时未获回应。

此次回归前，运营方曾向老用户发送「欢迎老用户回归」邮件，并赠送 1 个月会员。工作人员此前称，新版 App 与华数传媒合作，片源均为正版采购。
title_en: YYeTs App Pulled from App Stores Just 10 Days After Comeback
content_en:
The YYeTs (Renren Yingshi) app has once again disappeared from Apple's App Store and multiple Android app stores, just about 10 days after its highly anticipated return, Jiemian News reported on September 10.

While users who already installed the app can still open it, the content categories have been simplified from movies, US, UK, and Korean dramas into just two categories: "movies" and "dramas." Additionally, VIP subscription services have been suspended, and the app's news section has not been updated since August 26.

Prior to this sudden removal, the platform had sent emails welcoming back old users and offering a free one-month VIP membership. Representatives had previously claimed that the revamped app was operating in partnership with Wasu Media, with all content being legally licensed.

title_zh: 小米回应 N90「服务车」分类：私家车只需上牌前验车
content_zh:
小米汽车回应澎程 N90 Max 在工信部公告中被归为「插电式增程混合动力文化生活服务车」一事。公司表示，这一分类源于原厂配备的电动升降车顶；普通用户作为私家车使用时，主要差别是首次上牌前需要进行安全技术检验，并承担相应验车费用。

上牌后，车辆仍按小型普通客车的周期管理：前 6 年免上线检验，第 6 年和第 10 年上线检测，超过 10 年后每年检验一次。原厂电动升降车顶不需要在年检时拆除，限行规则也与普通小型客车一致；7 座及以下车型可正常享受重大节假日高速免费通行。

小米员工王化还说明，公告里的「文化生活服务车」是车辆产品类别，私家车不需要因此办理营运证，报废年限也不变。相关解释补上了发布会后用户最关心的上牌、年检和日常通行问题。
title_en: Xiaomi Clarifies "Service Vehicle" Classification for N90 Max SUV
content_en:
Xiaomi EV has addressed concerns regarding the classification of its Pengcheng N90 Max, which was listed in the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) catalog as a "plug-in range-extended hybrid cultural life service vehicle."

According to the company, this classification stems from the vehicle's factory-installed electric lifting roof. For private buyers, the only practical difference is that the vehicle must undergo a safety technical inspection and pay the associated fees before its initial registration.

Once registered, the N90 Max will be managed under the same rules as standard small passenger cars. It will be exempt from online inspections for the first six years, with mandatory inspections required only in the sixth and tenth years, and annually after ten years. The factory roof does not need to be removed for these inspections. Furthermore, the vehicle will face the same traffic restrictions as regular passenger cars and will enjoy free highway tolls during major holidays.

Xiaomi spokesperson Wang Hua clarified that the "cultural life service vehicle" label is merely a product classification. Private owners do not need to apply for commercial operating permits, and the vehicle's standard lifespan and scrapping regulations remain unchanged.

title_zh: DeepSeek 聘请中信证券筹备科创板 IPO
content_zh:
路透社 9 月 9 日援引两名知情人士报道称，DeepSeek 已聘请中信证券，为在上海科创板首次公开募股做准备。公司计划今年启动 IPO 流程，但潜在发行时间、募资规模和目标估值均未确定。

在境内上市流程中，企业通常会先聘请证券公司开展上市辅导，再正式递交申请。第一财经从知情人士处确认，中信证券已与 DeepSeek 接洽并进入尽职调查阶段，双方尚未签订正式上市辅导协议；DeepSeek 和中信证券也没有回应路透社的置评请求。

报道称，DeepSeek 希望为算力基础设施、模型研发以及核心人才招聘和留任筹集更多资金。创始人梁文锋希望通过上市为关键员工和研究人员提供更有竞争力的激励，但这项安排仍处于筹备阶段。
title_en: AI Startup DeepSeek Taps CITIC Securities for STAR Market IPO
content_en:
Chinese artificial intelligence startup DeepSeek has hired CITIC Securities to prepare for an initial public offering (IPO) on Shanghai's tech-focused STAR Market, Reuters reported on September 9, citing sources. The company plans to initiate the IPO process this year, though the timing, fundraising target, and valuation remain undecided.

According to First Financial, CITIC Securities has entered the due diligence phase with DeepSeek, though a formal pre-listing tutoring agreement has not yet been signed. In China's domestic market, companies typically undergo a period of official tutoring by a brokerage before formally submitting an IPO application. Neither DeepSeek nor CITIC Securities has officially commented on the reports.

The funds raised are expected to support DeepSeek's computing infrastructure, model research and development, and talent recruitment. Founder Liang Wenfeng reportedly aims to use the public listing to offer more competitive incentives to key researchers and employees, though the plans are still in the early stages.

title_zh: Bending Spoons 拟收购 Miro，交易预计四季度完成
content_zh:
Bending Spoons 9 月 10 日宣布已签署最终协议，拟以 13.55 亿美元的企业价值收购在线协作平台 Miro。计入 Miro 持有的净现金后，交易对应的股权价值约为 17.9 亿美元；部分 Miro 股东将从所得价款中拿出 2.95 亿美元，购买 Bending Spoons 新发行的股权。

Miro 目前被超过 25 万家机构纳入工作流，年度经常性收入约 6 亿美元，其中近 90% 来自商业及企业客户。公司有近 400 万付费用户，超过 750 家客户的年度经常性收入贡献超过 10 万美元。Bending Spoons 表示，交易完成后将投资 Miro 的性能、可靠性与协作功能。

这项交易已获双方董事会一致批准，还需取得监管许可并满足常规交割条件，预计于 2026 年第四季度完成。在交割前，两家公司将继续独立运营。
title_en: Bending Spoons to Acquire Collaboration Platform Miro for $1.79 Billion Equity Value
content_en:
Italian app developer Bending Spoons has signed a definitive agreement to acquire the online collaboration platform Miro. The transaction values Miro at an enterprise value of $1.355 billion, representing an equity value of approximately $1.79 billion after accounting for Miro's net cash. As part of the deal, select Miro shareholders will reinvest $295 million of their proceeds into newly issued Bending Spoons equity.

Miro currently boasts an annual recurring revenue (ARR) of approximately $600 million, with nearly 90% generated from commercial and enterprise clients. The platform is integrated into the workflows of over 250,000 organizations, serving nearly 4 million paying users. Additionally, more than 750 of its customers contribute over $100,000 in ARR. Following the acquisition, Bending Spoons plans to invest heavily in enhancing Miro's performance, reliability, and collaborative features.

The transaction has received unanimous approval from the boards of directors of both companies. Subject to regulatory approvals and customary closing conditions, the deal is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026. Until then, both companies will continue to operate independently.

title_zh: Adobe 第三财季营收 67.6 亿美元，AI 优先 ARR 同比增逾 150%
content_zh:
Adobe 9 月 10 日发布截至 8 月 28 日的 2026 财年第三财季业绩：营收为 67.6 亿美元，同比增长 13%；GAAP 净利润为 18.27 亿美元，摊薄每股收益为 4.62 美元；non-GAAP 净利润为 24.2 亿美元，摊薄每股收益为 6.13 美元。

期末 Adobe 年化经常性收入（ARR）为 275 亿美元。公司披露，AI 优先产品 ARR 同比增长超过 150%，创意与生产力产品的月活跃用户合计超过 10 亿。第三财季经营活动现金流为 25.2 亿美元，公司当季回购约 950 万股股票。

Adobe 预计第四财季营收为 68 亿至 68.5 亿美元，并将 2026 财年全年营收指引上调至 265.76 亿至 266.26 亿美元；全年 GAAP 摊薄每股收益指引为 18.12 至 18.17 美元。
title_en: Adobe Reports Strong Q3 FY2026 Results as AI-First ARR Surges Over 150%
content_en:
Adobe has announced its financial results for the third quarter of fiscal year 2026, ending August 28. The creative software giant reported revenue of $6.76 billion, representing a 13% year-over-year increase. GAAP net income reached $1.827 billion, or $4.62 per diluted share, while non-GAAP net income stood at $2.42 billion, or $6.13 per diluted share.

The company's annualized recurring revenue (ARR) reached $27.5 billion at the end of the quarter. Notably, ARR for Adobe's AI-first products surged by over 150% year-over-year, driven by strong adoption. The combined monthly active users for Adobe's creative and productivity suites have now surpassed 1 billion. During the quarter, Adobe generated $2.52 billion in operating cash flow and repurchased approximately 9.5 million shares.

Looking ahead, Adobe expects fourth-quarter revenue to range between $6.8 billion and $6.85 billion. The company has also raised its full-year fiscal 2026 revenue guidance to a range of $26.576 billion to $26.626 billion, with full-year GAAP diluted EPS projected between $18.12 and $18.17.

title_zh: 💡 外滩大会三位嘉宾：AI 新经济仍缺竞争、组织与验证基础
content_zh:
2026 Inclusion·外滩大会 9 月 10 日开幕。诺贝尔经济学奖得主菲利普·阿吉翁、源码资本投资合伙人张宏江和普林斯顿大学人工智能创新中心主任王梦迪，分别从经济制度、企业组织和科学验证讨论 AI 走向实际生产力仍需补足的条件。

阿吉翁与同事的研究估算，仅考虑 AI 自动化商品和服务生产中的任务，未来十年生产率增速每年可额外提高 0.68 个百分点；若加上 AI 促进新想法的作用，潜在提升约为 1.08 个百分点。他同时警告，上游云计算和 GPU 市场集中度较高，技术突破转化为持续增长，还取决于竞争政策、教育体系和劳动力市场保障。

张宏江认为，Agent 正从对话走向助手、从被动走向主动，并进一步形成多 Agent 的经济关系网络。企业的核心能力将包括把 IP、Know-how、用户关系和产品能力转化为模型，再通过 Agent 协作系统和可持续改进的工作流程形成组织层面的「涌现」。

王梦迪的团队发现，大模型容易高估最常见的情况，同时低估长尾分布；数学和编程之所以进展更快，与编译器、单元测试和形式化证明等明确「验证器」有关。她判断，AI 要自主发现新科学，需要能把假设、实验、追溯和复现连接起来的现实验证基础设施。她的团队正将量子材料实验设备封装为 API，并探索连接多模态 AI、研究人员和实验设备的 LabOS。
title_en: Bund Summit 2026: Experts Highlight Key Gaps in AI's Path to Real-World Productivity
content_en:
At the 2026 Inclusion·Bund Summit, which opened on September 10, three prominent experts shared their insights on the missing links required for artificial intelligence to transition into a true driver of economic productivity. Nobel laureate Philippe Aghion, Source Code Capital Venture Partner Zhang Hongjiang, and Princeton University AI Innovation Center Director Wang Mengdi analyzed these challenges through the lenses of economic policy, corporate organization, and scientific validation.

Philippe Aghion highlighted the massive economic potential of AI, estimating that automating goods and services production could boost annual productivity growth by 0.68 percentage points over the next decade. If AI's role in fostering new ideas is included, the potential increase rises to 1.08 percentage points. However, Aghion warned of high market concentration in upstream cloud computing and GPU sectors, emphasizing that turning technological breakthroughs into sustained growth depends heavily on robust competition policies, education systems, and labor market protections.

Focusing on corporate structure, Zhang Hongjiang discussed the evolution of AI agents from passive conversational tools to active assistants, which are now forming complex multi-agent economic networks. He noted that a company's core competitiveness will lie in its ability to codify proprietary intellectual property, industry know-how, user relationships, and product capabilities into models. This will enable organizational "emergence" through collaborative agent networks and continuously optimizing workflows.

Addressing scientific validation, Wang Mengdi pointed out that large language models often overestimate common scenarios while underestimating long-tail distributions. She noted that AI has progressed faster in mathematics and programming because of clear "validators" like compilers and unit tests. To autonomously discover new science, AI requires physical validation infrastructure that connects hypotheses, experiments, tracking, and replication. To address this, her team is wrapping quantum materials experimental equipment into APIs and developing "LabOS" to bridge multimodal AI, researchers, and laboratory hardware.

title_zh: iPhone 18 Pro 系列 Geekbench 跑分出现，单核约 4700 分
content_zh:
Geekbench 数据库 9 月 10 日出现多条型号为 iPhone19,2 和 iPhone19,3 的设备记录。其中一台 iPhone19,2 搭载 6 核处理器，频率为 4.93GHz，运行 iOS 27，显示可用内存 11.27GB，对应 12GB 内存配置。

该设备在 Geekbench 6.7.0 的单核成绩为 4719 分，多核为 12677 分。iPhone19,3 的 Metal 测试中则出现了 64069 分的记录。苹果新发布的 iPhone 18 Pro 系列搭载 A20 Pro，但 Geekbench 页面本身只显示设备代号与 ARM 处理器信息。

目前数据库内已有多次测试，单核成绩大多在 4700 分附近，多核与 Metal 成绩会随设备状态和测试环境浮动。这批样本可以用于确认频率和内存配置，不足以单独代表量产机的持续性能。
title_en: iPhone 18 Pro Geekbench Benchmarks Leak, Revealing A20 Pro Specs
content_en:
Early Geekbench benchmarks for Apple's upcoming iPhone 18 Pro series (identified as "iPhone19,2" and "iPhone19,3") have surfaced, offering a first look at the performance of the next-generation A20 Pro chip.

According to the database entries, the "iPhone19,2" features a 6-core processor clocked at an impressive 4.93 GHz, paired with 12GB of RAM (showing 11.27GB available) and running iOS 27. The device achieved a single-core score of 4,719 and a multi-core score of 12,677 on Geekbench 6.7.0. Meanwhile, the "iPhone19,3" variant recorded a Metal graphics score of 64,069.

While these early runs help confirm the chip's clock speed and memory configuration, experts note that these scores reflect pre-production hardware. Actual performance on retail units may vary depending on thermal management and final software optimization.

title_zh: 荣耀推动四家安卓厂商统一「碰一碰」互传标准
content_zh:
荣耀 MagicOS 9 月 9 日宣布，由荣耀主导制定的「碰一碰互传技术标准」已经落地，并与 OPPO、vivo、小米共同推进跨品牌支持。手机开启 NFC 后，可通过轻碰触发照片、视频和文件互传；应用开发者接入统一 SDK 后，可同时适配四家厂商的设备。

荣耀官网显示，其设备此前已经可以与小米、OPPO、vivo 等安卓手机免流量互传文件，新标准进一步把「碰一碰」触发方式开放给第三方应用。官方展示的场景包括碰一下分享短视频、转账或优惠券，后续也计划扩展到运动相机和车机等设备。

荣耀表示，MagicOS 11 将全面支持跨品牌「碰一碰」分享，荣耀 Magic9 系列首发搭载。各品牌的具体适配机型、应用范围和上线时间仍以产品更新为准。
title_en: Honor Partners with OPPO, vivo, and Xiaomi to Standardize "Tap-to-Share" File Transfers
content_en:
Honor's MagicOS has announced the implementation of a new "Tap-to-Share" technical standard. Developed under Honor's leadership, the standard is being co-promoted with OPPO, vivo, and Xiaomi to establish seamless, cross-brand file sharing.

By leveraging NFC, users can initiate instant transfers of photos, videos, and files simply by tapping their devices together. A unified SDK will also be made available to third-party developers, allowing them to easily integrate this tap-to-share functionality across all four smartphone brands. Potential use cases include sharing short videos, sending digital coupons, and making quick transfers.

The feature is set to expand beyond smartphones to action cameras and in-car systems. Honor has confirmed that MagicOS 11 will fully support this cross-brand sharing standard, making its debut on the upcoming Honor Magic9 series.

title_zh: 联通魅族「小魔方」展示现场体验，主打智能通话和端云协同
content_zh:
魅族 9 月 10 日公布了联通魅族「小魔方」在 2026 中国联通合作伙伴大会上的现场体验。这款随身 AI 终端采用圆角方屏和小型机身，通过屏幕数字人与语音交互承接操作，现场演示包括查询地点、点咖啡和控制智能家居。

通话场景中，「小魔方」展示了 AI 速记、翻译、聊天辅助和无障碍接听等功能。设备还以「云上空间」连接云存储、云端应用和端云双身份，让本地终端接收需求，云端承接应用与存储任务；现场也展示了短视频与 AI 对话同屏、通过摄像头识别眼前物体并查询信息等功能方向。
title_en: Meizu and China Unicom Showcase "Magic Cube" Portable AI Terminal
content_en:
At the 2026 China Unicom Partners Conference, Meizu showcased its new "Magic Cube" (Xiao Mo Fang) portable AI terminal. The compact device features a rounded square display and relies on an on-screen digital avatar and voice interaction to perform tasks such as ordering coffee, querying locations, and controlling smart home devices.

Designed with advanced communication features, the Magic Cube offers AI-powered call assistance, including real-time transcription, translation, conversation suggestions, and accessibility tools for answering calls.

The device also leverages a "cloud-edge synergy" model. Through its "Cloud Space" feature, the local terminal handles user inputs while offloading heavy application processing and storage to the cloud. Other demonstrated features include split-screen multitasking with short videos and AI chat, as well as real-time object recognition via the built-in camera.

title_zh: 豆包工作新增本地 Office 编辑、浏览器录制和执行环境切换
content_zh:
豆包工作上线三项功能。本地 Office 编辑目前可直接打开并修改电脑中的 PPT 和 Excel 文件，Word 支持随后加入；用户可以在同一任务中读取资料并继续修改文件，不必在应用之间来回导入导出。

浏览器录制与回放允许用户示范一次操作流程，再把录屏沉淀为可复用技能，适合重复但难以用文字完整描述的网页任务。该功能现阶段先在豆包浏览器内运行，官方计划随后扩展到整个电脑端。

任务执行环境也可在不中断对话的情况下切换「本地电脑」和「云电脑」，保留已有上下文，并远程调度其他已登录设备上的文件和算力。三项功能目前已在豆包工作全量上线。
title_en: Doubao Work Introduces Local Office Editing, Browser Recording, and Environment Switching
content_en:
ByteDance's Doubao Work has rolled out three major new features designed to streamline workflows and enhance productivity.

First, the platform now supports local Office editing, allowing users to directly open and modify PowerPoint and Excel files on their computers, with Word support coming soon. This eliminates the need to import and export files between different applications.

Second, a new browser recording and playback feature enables users to record a web-based task once and save it as a reusable automated skill. This feature is currently available within the Doubao Browser, with plans to expand to the entire desktop environment.

Lastly, users can now seamlessly switch their execution environment between "local PC" and "cloud PC" without interrupting ongoing conversations. This feature preserves context and allows users to remotely leverage files and computing power from other logged-in devices.

title_zh: OpenAI 开放 Agents API 公测，可直接调用 Codex Agent 基础设施
content_zh:
OpenAI 9 月 10 日宣布 Agents API 进入公开测试，面向所有开发者开放。开发者可在一次 API 调用中指定任务、模型、工具和运行环境，创建由 OpenAI 托管 Agent 框架的云端智能体；其底层使用与 Codex 相同的上下文管理、工具调度和多 Agent 协作能力。

运行环境可以选择 OpenAI 托管沙箱、自有基础设施或合作伙伴提供的沙箱。OpenAI 托管沙箱支持运行代码、处理文件、安装 Skill 和插件；会话接近上下文上限时，系统会自动压缩早期内容，以支持跨多个上下文窗口的长时间任务。

Agents API 还提供工具搜索、程序化工具调用和子 Agent 并行能力，支持 MCP、自定义函数与网页搜索等工具。公测阶段不额外收取 Agents API 费用，开发者按所用模型 token 和工具计费。
title_en: OpenAI Launches Public Beta of Agents API Powered by Codex Infrastructure
content_en:
OpenAI has launched the public beta of its Agents API, making it available to all developers. The new API allows developers to build cloud-based, OpenAI-hosted agents by specifying tasks, models, tools, and execution environments in a single API call. The system leverages the same context management, tool orchestration, and multi-agent collaboration capabilities as Codex.

Developers can run these agents in OpenAI-hosted sandboxes, their own infrastructure, or partner-provided sandboxes. The hosted sandbox supports code execution, file processing, and the installation of custom skills and plugins. To support long-running tasks, the API automatically compresses early conversation history as it approaches context limits.

Additionally, the Agents API supports tool search, programmatic tool calling, parallel sub-agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP), custom functions, and web search. During the public beta, OpenAI is not charging extra fees for the Agents API itself; developers will only be billed for the model tokens and tools consumed.

title_zh: 理想 2026 款 i6 申报，自研 5C 电芯由欣旺达和中创新航代工
content_zh:
工信部第 411 批新车申报信息出现 2026 款理想 i6。理想汽车产品负责人李昕旸随后表示，新车采用理想自研的 5C 电芯，欣旺达和中创新航负责电芯代工，电池 Pack 由理想生产；电芯、Pack 和 BMS 在内的整套电池系统均由理想主导设计。

这款车还将搭载理想自研的「马赫」芯片。按照公司公布的节奏，2026 款 i6 将在 9 月底开启预订，11 月初开始交付。具体续航、容量和车型配置仍要等待正式发布。

理想过去主要通过宁德时代等供应商采购电池系统，这次把电芯设计和 Pack 制造进一步纳入自研体系，同时保留外部厂商的规模化代工能力。公司尚未说明这套模式是否会扩展到更多车型，量产后的充电表现、一致性和供应稳定性仍需实际交付验证。
title_en: Li Auto Files 2026 i6 Featuring In-House 5C Battery Cells
content_en:
Li Auto's upcoming 2026 i6 has been registered with China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT). According to Li Xinyang, Li Auto's product head, the new model will feature the company's self-developed 5C battery cells. While Sunwoda and CALB will manufacture the cells, Li Auto will handle the battery pack assembly. The entire battery system—including cells, pack, and BMS—is designed in-house by Li Auto.

The 2026 i6 will also be equipped with Li Auto's proprietary "Mach" chip. Pre-orders for the new vehicle are scheduled to open in late September, with deliveries expected to begin in early November. Detailed specifications regarding range, battery capacity, and configurations will be announced at the official launch.

This move marks a strategic shift for Li Auto, which previously relied heavily on external suppliers like CATL for complete battery systems. By taking charge of cell design and pack manufacturing while outsourcing mass production, the company aims to tighten control over its supply chain. However, the real-world performance, consistency, and supply stability of this new model remain to be validated post-delivery.

title_zh: 国产 C909 完成 RNP AR 适航审定试飞
content_zh:
民航上海航空器适航审定中心试飞团队近日完成 C909 飞机 RNP AR 运行的多阶段审定试飞，覆盖平原、高原和高高原机场。测试验证了飞机在复杂地形、较低能见度和受限空域内按高精度航迹进近与离场的能力。

RNP AR 是需要特别授权的所需导航性能程序。飞机主要利用机载导航系统和卫星信号维持航迹，不依赖地面导航台，并能用更小的保护区绕开障碍物、降低进近标准。航空公司需要同时满足飞机性能、机组训练和运行批准等条件，才能实际执行这类程序。

本轮试飞为 C909 后续适航批准和航线扩展提供数据，尚不等于所有机场都已开放相关运行。C909 若取得相应批准，可在部分地形复杂或传统导航设施不足的机场获得更灵活的航路选择。
title_en: China's C909 Completes Key RNP AR Test Flights for Complex Terrain Navigation
content_en:
The test flight team of the Civil Aviation Administration of China (CAAC) Shanghai Aircraft Airworthiness Certification Center has successfully completed multi-stage certification test flights for the C909 aircraft's RNP AR (Required Navigation Performance Authorization Required) operations. The tests spanned various environments, including plain, plateau, and high-plateau airports.

RNP AR is an advanced navigation procedure that allows aircraft to fly highly precise flight paths using onboard navigation systems and GPS signals, eliminating the need for ground-based navigation aids. This capability enables safer maneuvers around obstacles in restricted airspace, lower visibility minimums, and more flexible routing.

While the successful test flights provide crucial data for the C909's subsequent airworthiness approvals and route expansions, it does not mean all airports are immediately open for such operations. Once fully approved, the C909 will gain significantly enhanced operational flexibility, particularly at airports with challenging terrain or limited ground navigation infrastructure.

title_zh: 环球音乐与 ElevenLabs 将推出授权 AI 音乐创作平台
content_zh:
环球音乐集团与 ElevenLabs 9 月 10 日宣布达成多年授权及战略合作，将推出一款基于授权音乐和艺人参与的 AI 音乐创作平台。这是 ElevenLabs 首次与大型唱片公司签署此类协议。

平台目前仍在开发中，计划让用户围绕参与艺人和词曲作者的作品制作混音、串烧、新版本及个性化人声体验。双方还将共同开发面向艺人与词曲作者的 AI 音频产品，并表示参与创作者将分享平台产生的价值。

公告暂未公布平台名称、上线时间及首批参与艺人。合作范围还包括未来数月和数年内继续开发新的产品与粉丝体验。
title_en: Universal Music Partners with ElevenLabs to Launch Licensed AI Music Creation Platform
content_en:
Universal Music Group (UMG) and AI voice technology firm ElevenLabs have announced a multi-year strategic partnership to launch a new AI-powered music creation platform. This marks ElevenLabs' first major partnership with a leading record label.

Currently under development, the platform will enable users to create remixes, mashups, new versions, and personalized vocal experiences using licensed music from participating artists and songwriters. The collaboration also aims to develop specialized AI audio tools for creators, ensuring that participating artists and songwriters share in the revenue generated by the platform.

While details regarding the platform's name, release date, and initial artist lineup have not yet been disclosed, both companies plan to roll out additional products and fan experiences over the coming months and years.

title_zh: Meta 推出个人 AI Agent Muse，可在关闭应用后继续执行任务
content_zh:
Meta 推出个人 AI Agent Muse，并开始在美国向 iOS、Android 和 muse.ai 用户开放，也可直接在 WhatsApp 中对话。用户可以让它发送邮件、预订旅行、打开浏览器填写表单或处理购物；较长任务会在应用关闭后继续运行，涉及发送邮件或付款等敏感操作时再请求确认。

Muse 运行在每名用户独立的 Muse Secure VM 中，连接服务的凭据存入隔离存储，Agent 本身看不到密码和支付方式。另一个与 Muse 系统级隔离的 Sentinel Agent 会检查对外网络操作，用户也能查看完整操作记录、限制每项服务的权限，或要求 Muse 忘记特定信息。

支付方面，Muse 首先接入 Stripe 的 Link，通过一次性卡号隐藏真实银行卡信息，Shop Pay 与 1Password 支持随后上线。Meta 称基础使用免费，更多用量采用订阅方案；今年晚些时候还将推出由用户独自持有密钥的 Confidential VM。
title_en: Meta Launches 'Muse' Personal AI Agent Capable of Background Task Execution
content_en:
Meta has introduced "Muse," a personal AI agent now rolling out to users in the United States across iOS, Android, WhatsApp, and muse.ai. Muse is designed to handle complex tasks such as sending emails, booking travel, filling out web forms, and managing online shopping. Notably, long-running tasks will continue to execute in the background even after the app is closed, though sensitive actions like payments or sending emails will always require user confirmation.

To address privacy and security concerns, each user's Muse agent runs within an isolated "Muse Secure VM." Credentials for connected services are kept in segregated storage, meaning the agent itself cannot access passwords or raw payment details. Additionally, a system-isolated "Sentinel Agent" monitors all outbound network activity. Users retain full control with access to complete activity logs, the ability to restrict permissions, and an option to command Muse to delete specific data.

For transactions, Muse initially integrates with Stripe's Link, utilizing one-time virtual card numbers to protect actual banking details, with support for Shop Pay and 1Password coming soon. While basic usage of Muse is free, Meta plans to offer subscription tiers for heavier workloads. Later this year, Meta also plans to launch "Confidential VMs," where users hold the exclusive decryption keys.

title_zh: 吉利银河 TT 上市，全系搭载 800V 平台和激光雷达
content_zh:
吉利银河 TT 9 月 10 日正式上市，共推出 5 款车型，指导价为 13.99 万至 19.59 万元。10 月 7 日前下定可获得购置税和保险现金补贴，补贴后价格为 12.99 万至 18.59 万元。新车在预售期间收到超过 2 万份小订订单。

银河 TT 全系采用 800V 高压平台、宁德时代神行 TT 高定磷酸铁锂电池和前双叉臂后五连杆底盘。后驱版搭载最大功率 245kW 电机，提供 640km 和 725km 两种 CLTC 续航；6C 快充支持最快约 11.6 分钟将电量从 10% 充至 80%。

全系车型都配备激光雷达，分别提供千里浩瀚 G-ASD H5 和 H7 辅助驾驶方案。顶配 TT Ultra 使用前后双电机，综合功率 425kW，零百加速 3.8 秒，正式上市后每月限量发售 460 台。

🔗 相关阅读：补贴后 12.99 万元起，银河 TT 上市：全系 800V+宁德时代定制电池
title_en: Geely Galaxy TT Launched: 800V Architecture and LiDAR Standard Across All Trims
content_en:
Geely has officially launched the Galaxy TT, offering five variants with a price range of RMB 139,900 to 195,900. Customers placing orders before October 7 can enjoy subsidies, bringing the starting price down to RMB 129,900. The vehicle has already garnered over 20,000 pre-orders.

The entire Galaxy TT lineup is built on an 800V high-voltage platform, equipped with CATL's customized Shenxing TT lithium iron phosphate (LFP) batteries. It features a chassis with front double-wishbone and rear five-link suspension. The rear-wheel-drive version is powered by a 245kW motor, offering CLTC ranges of 640km and 725km. With 6C fast charging, the battery can charge from 10% to 80% in approximately 11.6 minutes.

In terms of smart driving, all models come standard with LiDAR, utilizing either the Qianli Haohan G-ASD H5 or H7 assisted driving systems. The top-of-the-line TT Ultra variant features dual motors with a combined output of 425kW, achieving 0-100 km/h acceleration in 3.8 seconds. This premium trim will be limited to 460 units per month.

title_zh: 全新智己 LS6 开启预售，全系标配全线控底盘
content_zh:
全新一代智己 LS6 9 月 10 日开启预售，共推出 3 款纯电车型，预售价为 20.99 万至 26.49 万元。三款车分别配备 76kWh、93kWh 和 103kWh 电池，CLTC 续航为 650km、782km 和 750km，其中 Ultra 版采用双电机四驱，零百加速为 3.48 秒。

新车全系搭载 NEO 三电架构与全线控灵蜴底盘。线控转向将方向盘动作转换为电信号再驱动前轮，支持低速半圈打满；配合后轮转向，最小转弯半径为 4.49 米。系统设置双电源、双通信和双硬件备份，后轮转向与制动系统还可在前轮转向双重失效时协同减速停车。

智己称，SynVector 全域线控矢量扭矩协同控制可统一调节动力、制动和转向，底盘响应最快为 20ms。辅助驾驶由 Momenta 物理 AI 世界模型支持，座舱内的 IM Claw 智能体则用于拆解行程规划等连续任务。
title_en: New IM LS6 Starts Pre-Sales, Featuring Drive-by-Wire Chassis as Standard
content_en:
IM Motors has kicked off pre-sales for the next-generation IM LS6, offering three pure electric variants priced between RMB 209,900 and 264,900. The models are equipped with 76kWh, 93kWh, and 103kWh battery packs, delivering CLTC ranges of 650km, 782km, and 750km, respectively. The top-tier Ultra version features a dual-motor all-wheel-drive system, capable of accelerating from 0 to 100 km/h in just 3.48 seconds.

The new LS6 comes standard with the NEO powertrain architecture and the fully drive-by-wire "Liangyi" digital chassis. Its steer-by-wire system translates steering wheel movements into electrical signals to drive the front wheels, supporting a low-speed half-turn lock. Combined with rear-wheel steering, the vehicle achieves a remarkably tight minimum turning radius of 4.49 meters. For safety, the system includes dual power, dual communication, and dual hardware backups, allowing the rear-wheel steering and braking systems to safely decelerate and stop the car if the front steering fails.

Additionally, the SynVector digital vector torque control system coordinates power, braking, and steering with a response time of just 20ms. The vehicle's advanced driver assistance system (ADAS) is powered by Momenta's physical AI world model, while the in-cabin IM Claw smart agent assists users with complex, multi-step tasks such as itinerary planning.

title_zh: Suno 发布 v6，将逐步停用旧模型
content_zh:
Suno 9 月 9 日发布 v6 系列音乐生成模型，称这代模型与 Warner Music Group、BMG 和 Believe 等音乐产业伙伴共同开发。系列包含面向 Pro 和 Premier 订阅用户的旗舰模型 v6、强调探索性的 v6-wild，以及向所有用户开放的轻量版本 v6-mini。

新模型支持用自然语言局部修改歌曲、把多个来源组合成混音、采样并分离乐器片段，还能根据文字、音频、图片和视频生成音乐。Suno 表示，v6 上线后会逐步停用此前的模型，并把平台迁移到 v6 系列；用户已经生成的歌曲仍会保留在资料库中，可继续播放、分享和用于翻唱或混音。

Believe 与 Suno 的协议允许旗下艺术家和厂牌自愿把作品纳入新模型，并在参与时获得报酬；使用新产业伙伴模型创作的歌曲，也可通过 Believe 和 TuneCore 发行。Suno 还计划推出围绕单个艺术家的自愿参与产品，让艺术家决定是否授权并从中获得收入。
title_en: Suno Launches v6 Music Generation Model, Phasing Out Older Versions
content_en:
Suno has officially released its v6 music generation model, developed in collaboration with major music industry partners including Warner Music Group, BMG, and Believe. The new lineup features the flagship v6 model for Pro and Premier subscribers, the exploratory v6-wild model, and a lightweight v6-mini version available to all users.

The v6 model introduces advanced capabilities, allowing users to make localized edits to songs using natural language, remix multiple sources, and sample or isolate instrument tracks. It can also generate music from text, audio, images, and videos. Suno plans to gradually phase out its older models as it transitions the platform entirely to the v6 series. However, users' existing creations will remain in their libraries for playback, sharing, and remixing.

Through its partnership with Believe, artists and labels can voluntarily opt-in to have their work included in the new model's training data in exchange for compensation. Music created using these industry-partnered models can also be distributed through Believe and TuneCore. Furthermore, Suno plans to launch artist-specific opt-in programs, allowing individual creators to control licensing and earn revenue from their work.

title_zh: Spark-X2.5 开源 4B 和 1.7B 模型，原生支持 1M 上下文
content_zh:
SparkLLM 开源 Spark-X2.5 系列，包含 4B 和 1.7B 两种参数规模，并提供可直接推理的发布版、用于继续训练的 Base 版和适合本地运行的 GGUF 版。模型采用全量注意力与滑动窗口注意力混合架构，原生支持最长 1M token 上下文和 200 余种语言。

官方称，Spark-X2.5 使用约 20 万亿 token 数据预训练，并用千亿 token 长上下文数据进行专项训练；后训练覆盖数学、编程、工具调用和指令遵循，还通过多教师在线策略蒸馏把不同领域教师模型的能力合并到统一模型中。相关基准成绩均为官方测试，尚需更多独立评测验证。

部署方面，模型兼容 SGLang、vLLM、llama.cpp 和 MLX，可在 Ollama、LM Studio 等工具中运行，并适配英伟达、华为、海光等硬件平台。官方已在 ModelScope 提供模型合集、推理模板和多种运行方式的说明。
title_en: SparkLLM Open-Sources Spark-X2.5 Models (4B & 1.7B) with Native 1M Context Support
content_en:
SparkLLM has open-sourced its Spark-X2.5 model series, featuring 4B and 1.7B parameter sizes. The release includes inference-ready, Base (for continued training), and GGUF (for local execution) versions. Utilizing a hybrid architecture of full attention and sliding window attention, the models natively support a context window of up to 1 million tokens and over 200 languages.

The Spark-X2.5 models were pre-trained on approximately 20 trillion tokens, with an additional 100 billion tokens dedicated to specialized long-context training. Post-training enhancements focus on mathematics, programming, tool calling, and instruction following, leveraging a multi-teacher online distillation strategy to consolidate capabilities from various domain-specific models.

In terms of deployment, the models are compatible with SGLang, vLLM, llama.cpp, and MLX, and can run on tools like Ollama and LM Studio. They support hardware platforms from Nvidia, Huawei, and Hygon. Model collections, inference templates, and deployment guides are now available on ModelScope.

title_zh: Sonos 27 上线，可用 ChatGPT、Claude 等 AI 控制音响
content_zh:
Sonos 9 月 8 日开始向 S2 产品免费推送 Sonos 27 软件更新。更新加入实验性的 Sonos 27mcp：用户可通过模型上下文协议，把 ChatGPT、Claude 等外部 AI 助手连接到 Sonos 系统，再用自然语言搜索、播放和管理音乐。

更新还允许两只相同型号的便携音箱临时充当家庭影院环绕声道。音箱靠近兼容的 Sonos 条形音响时可以自动识别房间并切换角色，带走后则恢复为独立音箱。Sonos Ace Ultra 耳机连接音响系统的 Early Access 计划会在 9 月 29 日开放。

Sonos 同时重做了应用导航，把「首页」「系统」和「搜索」放到底部标签栏，并更新 iPad 界面、音量控制和 Siri 快捷指令。AI 连接目前仍处于 Early Access，不同硬件支持的功能也有差异；自家的语音功能 Sonos 27voice 计划在今年秋季推出。
title_en: Sonos 27 Update Enables AI Control via ChatGPT and Claude
content_en:
Sonos has begun rolling out its free Sonos 27 software update to S2 products. The update introduces an experimental feature, "Sonos 27mcp," which leverages the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to connect external AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude to the Sonos system. This allows users to search, play, and manage music using natural language.

Additionally, the update enables two identical portable speakers to temporarily serve as surround sound channels for a home theater setup. When placed near a compatible Sonos soundbar, the speakers automatically recognize the room and switch roles, reverting to independent speakers once moved away. Early access for connecting Sonos Ace Ultra headphones to the sound system will open on September 29.

The update also features a redesigned app navigation bar, placing "Home," "System," and "Search" at the bottom, alongside improvements to the iPad interface, volume controls, and Siri Shortcuts. While the AI integration is currently in Early Access with varying hardware support, Sonos plans to launch its proprietary voice feature, "Sonos 27voice," later this fall.

title_zh: 百灵开源 Ling-3.0-flash-VL，用视觉反馈持续修正 Agent 操作
content_zh:
百灵大模型开源 Ling-3.0-flash-VL 的 BF16 和 FP8 版本。模型共有 124B 参数，单次推理激活 5.5B 参数，主打在前端开发、GUI 自动化和医疗报告辅助解读等任务中，通过视觉反馈反复执行「观察、行动、验证、修正」。

在网页复刻任务中，模型可以读取截图、生成前端代码、查看浏览器渲染结果，再根据与参考图的差异继续修改；在跨工具任务中，它会根据当前界面状态调整点击、输入和滚动步骤。实时视觉能力也已接入灵光 App，用于识别物体、标识和场景并进行连续问答。

官方同时列出模型边界：长尾场景感知、长链路 Agent 执行、长程全栈编码、异常恢复和结果稳定性仍与最佳模型存在差距。FP4 和 INT4 版本计划随后发布，现有 BF16、FP8 权重已在 Hugging Face 与 ModelScope 上线。
title_en: Bailing Open-Sources Ling-3.0-flash-VL, Utilizing Visual Feedback for Agent Self-Correction
content_en:
Bailing has open-sourced the BF16 and FP8 versions of its Ling-3.0-flash-VL model. Featuring 124 billion total parameters with 5.5 billion activated per inference, the model is designed to perform continuous "observe, act, verify, and correct" loops using visual feedback. It is optimized for tasks such as front-end development, GUI automation, and medical report interpretation.

In web replication tasks, the model can analyze screenshots, generate front-end code, inspect browser rendering results, and make iterative adjustments based on visual differences from the reference image. For cross-tool workflows, it dynamically adjusts clicks, inputs, and scrolling actions based on the current UI state. This real-time visual capability has also been integrated into the Lingguang app for continuous visual Q&A.

The developers noted that the model still lags behind top-tier models in long-tail perception, long-chain agent execution, long-range full-stack coding, anomaly recovery, and output stability. While FP4 and INT4 versions are planned for future release, the BF16 and FP8 weights are now available on Hugging Face and ModelScope.

title_zh: DeepMind 开放 AlphaGenome Atlas，预计算 90 亿种人类基因变异
content_zh:
Google DeepMind 9 月 8 日发布 AlphaGenome Atlas，预先计算人类基因组约 90 亿种单核苷酸变异的分子影响。这个约 1PB 的数据集覆盖每一种可能的单字母变化，学术研究人员可通过免费网页入口查询，也可使用 AlphaGenome API。

Atlas 为每个变异提供跨多种细胞类型和组织的分子效应预测，并新增 AlphaGenome Variant Impact 分数，把 AlphaGenome 对基因调控的预测与 AlphaMissense 对蛋白质变化的判断合并为一个指标。该分数同时覆盖编码区和占基因组约 98% 的非编码区。

DeepMind 称，合作研究人员已用这套数据识别并实验验证未解罕见病中的关键变异；在超过 5.4 万名英国生物样本库参与者的数据中，研究者还找到了多 22% 的非编码区遗传关联。相关结果仍需针对具体疾病继续做实验和临床验证。
title_en: Google DeepMind Launches AlphaGenome Atlas to Map 9 Billion Human Gene Mutations
content_en:
Google DeepMind has officially released the AlphaGenome Atlas, a massive 1-petabyte dataset that precomputes the molecular impacts of approximately 9 billion single-nucleotide variants in the human genome. Covering every possible single-letter genetic change, the dataset is freely accessible to academic researchers via a web portal and the AlphaGenome API.

The Atlas introduces the "AlphaGenome Variant Impact" score, which integrates DeepMind's gene regulation predictions with AlphaMissense's protein change assessments. This unified metric covers both coding regions and the non-coding regions that make up 98% of the human genome, predicting molecular effects across various cell types and tissues.

Collaborating researchers have already leveraged this data to identify and experimentally validate critical variants in unsolved rare diseases. Furthermore, analyzing data from over 54,000 UK Biobank participants led to the discovery of 22% more genetic associations in non-coding regions. DeepMind notes that these findings still require further disease-specific experimental and clinical validation.

title_zh: 高德上线「避雷指南 1.0」，从 15 个维度预判出行风险
content_zh:
高德 9 月 10 日在扫街榜 2026 发布会上上线「避雷指南 1.0」。该功能采用高德地图 App 内的 AI 对话形式，不会生成此前网传的商家负面榜单。用户提交目的地或行程计划后，系统会结合实时动态感知和时空推演给出风险提示。

该功能会从营业时间、行程节奏、停车条件和拥挤程度等 15 个维度识别闭店、长时间排队、交通拥堵和时间冲突。界面新闻实测时，系统还会提示餐厅不同时段的菜品供应、同名档口差异及午间排队情况，并据此调整出行方案。

高德本次还发布飞行街景 2.0 和导航 Live。前者用于提前浏览目的地的三维空间，后者支持在驾车与步行场景中连续对话，并结合摄像头提供实景指路、菜单查看和文物讲解。
title_en: Amap Launches AI-Powered 'Pitfall Guide' to Predict Travel Risks Across 15 Dimensions
content_en:
Chinese mapping giant Amap has launched "Avoid Pitfalls Guide 1.0," an AI-powered conversational feature within its app designed to help users anticipate travel risks. Rather than generating negative merchant blacklists as previously rumored, the tool analyzes user destinations and itineraries to provide real-time risk alerts.

The system evaluates travel plans across 15 dimensions, including business hours, itinerary pacing, parking availability, and crowding. It can identify potential issues such as store closures, long queues, traffic congestion, and scheduling conflicts. Real-world testing shows the AI can even warn users about dish availability at different hours, differences between similarly named stalls, and lunchtime wait times, adjusting travel plans accordingly.

Alongside this feature, Amap introduced "Flying Street View 2.0," which allows users to preview destinations in 3D, and "Navigation Live." The latter supports continuous voice dialogue during driving or walking, utilizing the phone's camera to offer real-world navigation, menu translation, and historical site explanations.

title_zh: 支付宝把「碰一下」接入外滩大会 AI 会务和逛街助手
content_zh:
支付宝 9 月 9 日宣布，2026 Inclusion·外滩大会现场将通过 NFC「碰一下」覆盖入场、支付、借充电宝、留资和打卡领礼品等环节。

参会者触碰现场设备后，可以唤起大会 AI 助手，查询会展信息和现场地图，获得议程推荐、路线指引、资料获取与名片交换方式等建议。在「未来综合体」展区，「碰一下」还可启动 AI 逛街助手，演示智慧停车、购物导览和预约餐厅等线下服务。
title_en: Alipay Integrates 'Tap' NFC Feature with AI Assistants for Bund Summit
content_en:
Alipay has announced that its NFC-enabled "Tap" (Peng Yixia) feature will be deeply integrated into the upcoming 2026 Inclusion·Bund Summit. Attendees can use the tap-to-connect technology for entry, payments, power bank rentals, information submission, and collecting event gifts.

By tapping designated on-site devices, participants can summon an AI conference assistant. This assistant provides real-time exhibition information, venue maps, personalized agenda recommendations, route guidance, and digital business card exchanges.

Additionally, in the summit's "Future Complex" exhibition zone, the "Tap" feature will activate an AI shopping assistant. This tool will showcase smart offline services, including automated parking, shopping navigation, and restaurant reservations.

title_zh: 星巴克中国公布新一届咖啡公使
content_zh:
星巴克中国 9 月 9 日举行第十一届中国咖啡师大赛总决赛，来自合肥的侯懿林获得「星巴克中国咖啡公使」称号，来自南京的陆杨获得「星巴克中国臻选咖啡公使」称号。本届赛事由 5 月启动，共有 5000 余名星巴克伙伴报名，经过 660 余场赛事选出 11 名总决赛选手。

大赛首次分为核心组与臻选组，参赛者使用的咖啡豆、咖啡机和冲煮器具与两类门店的日常运营条件对应。总决赛包含咖啡盲品、拿铁艺术、冲煮与故事、高峰挑战和创意特调五个项目，综合考察专业技能、感官能力、创新和顾客沟通。

星巴克今年还首次面向钻星、金星会员开放「冠军展演」，会员可在 App 内预约到店，体验区域冠军的冲煮咖啡、拿铁艺术和创意饮品。公司于今年 4 月新设专职 ACM（区域咖啡大师）岗位，由全国 50 余位 ACM 负责咖啡教育和人才培养。
title_en: Starbucks China Crowns New Coffee Ambassadors in National Championship
content_en:
Starbucks China has crowned its newest coffee ambassadors at the grand finale of the 11th China Barista Championship on September 9. Hou Yilin from Hefei was named the "Starbucks China Coffee Ambassador," while Lu Yang from Nanjing secured the title of "Starbucks China Reserve Coffee Ambassador." The competition, which kicked off in May, drew over 5,000 participants across more than 660 rounds, culminating in 11 finalists competing for the top honors.

For the first time, the championship was divided into Core and Reserve categories, aligning the equipment, coffee beans, and brewing tools with the daily operations of Starbucks' standard and Reserve stores. Finalists were tested across five rigorous segments: blind tasting, latte art, brewing and storytelling, peak challenge, and creative beverage crafting.

In addition to the competition, Starbucks introduced "Champion Showcases" for Diamond and Gold members, allowing them to book in-store experiences to enjoy award-winning brewing and latte art. This initiative follows the company's launch of the Area Coffee Master (ACM) role in April, with over 50 ACMs now dedicated to coffee education and talent development across China.

title_zh: 《鲸口脱险》发布新预告，男主被困鲸腹仅剩一小时氧气
content_zh:
20 世纪影业发布惊悚片《鲸口脱险》（Whalefall）新正式预告。影片改编自 Daniel Kraus 的同名小说，由 Brian Duffield 执导并与原作者共同编剧，将于 10 月 16 日在北美上映。

故事围绕 Austin Abrams 饰演的 Jay Gardiner 展开。他在父亲去世后潜入加州中部海岸寻找遗骸，却被一头抹香鲸吞下，只剩一小时氧气；Josh Brolin 饰演其父亲，Elisabeth Shue、John Ortiz、Jane Levy 和 Emily Rudd 共同出演。

预告将主要篇幅放在鲸腹中的封闭逃生过程，同时通过回忆交代父子关系。父亲此前传授的潜水经验成为主角寻找出口的关键。
title_en: 20th Century Studios Drops Gripping Trailer for Survival Thriller 'Whalefall'
content_en:
20th Century Studios has released a tense new trailer for the upcoming thriller *Whalefall*, scheduled to hit North American theaters on October 16. Directed by Brian Duffield, who also co-wrote the screenplay with novelist Daniel Kraus, the film is adapted from Kraus's acclaimed novel of the same name.

The story follows Jay Gardiner (played by Austin Abrams), who dives off the coast of Central California to retrieve his late father's remains, only to be swallowed alive by a massive sperm whale. Trapped inside the beast with only one hour of oxygen left, Jay must find a way out. Josh Brolin stars as his father, alongside a supporting cast that includes Elisabeth Shue, John Ortiz, Jane Levy, and Emily Rudd.

The trailer highlights the claustrophobic struggle for survival inside the whale, interspersed with emotional flashbacks of the protagonist's relationship with his father. Ultimately, the diving wisdom passed down by his father becomes Jay's only hope for escape.

title_zh: Netflix 将《孤鸽镇》改编为连续剧
content_zh:
Netflix 已直接预订《孤鸽镇》连续剧，Zoe Kazan 和 Jeb Stuart 共同担任主创及执行制片人。项目改编自 Larry McMurtry 的普利策奖小说，Teton Ridge 负责制作；该公司今年 2 月取得了小说及相关作品的影视改编权。

故事仍围绕退役的德州骑警 Augustus McCrae 和 Woodrow Call 展开，两人带领牛群从格兰德河前往蒙大拿，在途中经历边境生活、冲突与失去。Netflix 把它定位为可持续展开的西部剧，而非一次性的迷你剧重拍。

1989 年 CBS 曾把《孤鸽镇》拍成四集迷你剧，由 Robert Duvall 和 Tommy Lee Jones 主演，并获得皮博迪奖、多项艾美奖和金球奖。Netflix 尚未公布新版演员阵容、开拍时间和上线日期。
title_en: Netflix Orders 'Lonesome Dove' Adaptation as an Ongoing Western Series
content_en:
Netflix has handed a straight-to-series order for a new adaptation of *Lonesome Dove*, the Pulitzer Prize-winning novel by Larry McMurtry. The project will be spearheaded by Zoe Kazan and Jeb Stuart, who are set to write and executive produce. Production company Teton Ridge, which acquired the film and television rights to the novel and its universe in February, will produce the series.

The story follows retired Texas Rangers Augustus McCrae and Woodrow Call as they lead a cattle drive from the Rio Grande to Montana, navigating the harsh realities, conflicts, and losses of frontier life. Rather than a limited miniseries, Netflix is positioning the project as an ongoing Western drama series with potential for multiple seasons.

This marks the first major adaptation of the novel since the iconic 1989 CBS miniseries starring Robert Duvall and Tommy Lee Jones, which won a Peabody Award, multiple Emmys, and Golden Globes. Netflix has not yet announced the cast, production timeline, or release date for the new series.

title_zh: Godzilla Minus Zero 首支预告公布，故事推进至 1949 年
content_zh:
东宝发布 Godzilla Minus Zero 首支带英文字幕的预告。影片由山崎贵执导，是 2023 年电影《哥斯拉-1.0》的续作，故事发生在前作两年后的 1949 年日本；神木隆之介回归饰演敷岛浩一。

预告显示，哥斯拉在前作结尾留下的细胞继续再生，并以新的形态回归。制作方称，这是第一部专门为 IMAX 拍摄的日本电影，山崎贵继续同时负责导演、编剧和视觉特效。

影片将于 9 月 26 日在纽约电影节举行世界首映，11 月作为东京国际电影节核心展映片亮相，并计划于 11 月 6 日在北美上映。日本及其他地区的完整发行安排尚未全部公布。
title_en: 'Godzilla Minus Zero' First Trailer Teases 1949 Setting and a Regenerated Beast
content_en:
Toho has unveiled the first English-subtitled trailer for *Godzilla Minus Zero*, the highly anticipated sequel to the acclaimed 2023 hit *Godzilla Minus One*. Directed by Takashi Yamazaki, the new film fast-forwards two years to 1949 post-war Japan, with Ryunosuke Kamiki reprising his role as Koichi Shikishima.

The teaser reveals that Godzilla's surviving cells from the climax of the previous film have continued to regenerate, paving the way for the monster's return in a terrifying new form. Notably, this installment marks the first Japanese film shot specifically for IMAX, with Yamazaki once again pulling triple duty as director, writer, and visual effects supervisor.

*Godzilla Minus Zero* is set to make its world premiere at the New York Film Festival on September 26, followed by a featured screening at the Tokyo International Film Festival in November. The film is scheduled for a North American theatrical release on November 6, with full global distribution details to be announced at a later date.
